frozen_at: 2026-09-19T00:00:00+08:00 (pre-run; timestamp recorded at run launch in manifest)

window.signal_grid: month-end trading days; 2020-12-31 dropped as signal (P3R2 precedent), kept as expiry anchor

dedup.representative: max |t_ic| (ties: higher coverage, then factor_id lexicographic)

composite.pool: r16.signal_pools verbatim (mainboard, isST=0, listing>120 sessions, amt_med20>=50M, close>=2)
composite.coverage_rule: symbol eligible iff >= ceil(M/2) representative factors non-null at t (arm-independent)
composite.component: x_i = (rank_pct - 0.5) * sign(ic_mean_i), ranked within executable cross-section

arms.F3-ICW: sum(abs(icir_i) * x_i) / sum(abs(icir_i)) over available components (pre-run clarification: components are sign-oriented, weights are |icir|)

intent_mapping.buy: target_weight=0.10, priority=composite rank, decision=(T,'pm'), expiry=T'+1 calendar day
intent_mapping.rescale: none (registered note: no mid-cycle weight correction)

benchmarks.B1m: executable pool equal-weight monthly, fractional, exposure=1, rate-only fee schedule
benchmarks.B3prime: random K=10, seeds 17-36 (20 runs), STOCK_FEE_SCHEDULE integer lots, exposure=1, mean net CAGR

gates: R16 prereg section 2 eight gates verbatim (P3R1/P3R2 precedent) + goal-alignment criterion dev net CAGR >= 10%
